serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Hello Mrs. Are you fishing, perhaps?
Mrs. Fisher: That’s exactly what I’m doing, kid.
You: In this water? Is it even possible to catch something here?
Mrs. Fisher: Of course it is. Do you think I would just stand with a fishing rod in my hands if I couldn’t catch anything?
You: No?
Mrs. Fisher: Just take a look into my cooler.
I can’t believe it, it’s almost full of fish!
You: But how is it possible?
Mrs. Fisher: Nature will always find a way, kid. No matter how hard people try to defy it.
You: Are those fish even safe to eat? What about the pollution?
Mrs. Fisher: The ones that look healthy are more or less safe to eat.
You: More or less? You aren’t very convincing.
Mrs. Fisher: Kid, I have been fishing here and eating those fish for years and I’m still alive. 
Mrs. Fisher: Besides, it’s not like whatever slop they are selling at supermarkets these days would be any better for you.
You: There’s some truth to that.
Mrs. Fisher: Are you perhaps interested in fishing?
You: Me? Not really. I never even tried it.
Mrs. Fisher: It might be a good chance to try. Here, grab my rod.  
You: Are you serious?
Mrs. Fisher: Of course. I never joke about fishing.
You: No no no, I really can’t, what if I break it?
Mrs. Fisher: Hold it tight, boy!
